corpus_impact: 38 of 1146 nanoflow expressions in the public corpus and the SPC project used unsupported functions, tokens or association paths; none remain
native_semantics: string functions follow JavaScript: trim removes Unicode blanks, substring(text, start, length) never fails, find/findLast are indexOf/lastIndexOf
regular expressions use JavaScript syntax; (?i) is invalid; isMatch matches the whole text; replacements are literal
urlEncode is encodeURIComponent; urlDecode reads + as a space
empty string arguments read as '' and concatenating empty or numbers yields text
[%EndOf...%] tokens are the next period start minus 1 ms
getCaption uses the enumeration caption, getKey and toString the key
limitations: week tokens, length tokens and [%CurrentUser%] are rejected
association paths read only the associated objects embedded by the server (one level)
